title: Quietly Dense Greek Oats Tiropita
description: A fatty and dense Greek dish featuring porridge oats, shio-cure, and Buddhist-temple-friendly ingredients, formed into a tiropita and served in a bento-box.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the porridge oats, shio-cure, feta cheese, kalamata olives, sun dried tomatoes, fresh parsley, lemon zest, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Gradually add the olive oil to the bowl and mix until the ingredients are well combined.
Unroll the phyllo dough and cut it into 4 equal pieces.
Place a quarter of the oat mixture onto the center of each phyllo piece.
Brush the edges of the phyllo with a little water and fold the dough into a triangle, pressing the edges to seal.
Place the tiropita into a bento-box and brush the tops with a little olive oil.
Bake the tiropita in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the tiropita from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
